sloka: पद्म पत्र विशालाक्षीम् सततम् प्रिय पन्कजाम् ।अपश्यतो मे वैदेहीम् जीवितम् न अभिरोचते  ॥४-१-६७॥
transliteration: padma patra viśālākṣīm satatam priya pankajām ।apaśyato me vaidehīm jīvitam na abhirocate  ॥4-1-67॥

translations.english: 'Oh how adversly disposed is the god of love He makes me remember that auspicious lady with a pleasing voice when she is lost and difficult to reach.
